mapper.insert: UPDATE roomprice SET roomType = #{roomType}, roomP = #{roomPrice}, roomSp = #{roomSPrice}, roomUp = #{roomUPrice} WHERE roomType = #{roomType}
mapper.select: SELECT A.roomType AS "roomType", A.roomId AS "roomId", A.roomNm AS "roomNm", COALESCE(B.roomP, '') AS "roomPrice", COALESCE(B.roomSp, '') AS "roomSPrice", COALESCE(B.roomUp, '') AS "roomUPrice" FROM room A LEFT JOIN roomprice B ON A.roomType = B.roomType
